result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer stops it or `git-history.zip` from being written. The `reports` module compiles. I did not run any tests, and I did not try a renamed-aspect config end to end.

The change is in `exportJson` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are replaced by a loop over the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects. For each aspect it calls `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same helper that names the loose text files, so the lookup and the zip entry use the same name. The order is unchanged.

With the default configuration the entries are the same as before. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written as before, because the `all_files.zip` step no longer throws.
